ZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT ANDDECLARATIONOFRESTRICTIONS Agreement (this “Agreement”or “Declaration") made as of the 12th day of December, 2002 between 691 EIGHTH AVENUE CORP. ("Owner"), a New York corporation, having an address c/o Mark Friedlander, Esq., 15 Maiden Lane,Suite 2000, New York, New York 10038, and 306 West 44 LLC, a New York limited liability company ("Developer"), a New York limited liability company, having an address c/o Lowell Harwood, 26 Journal Square, Suite 804, Jersey City, New Jersey 07306. Owner is the owner of certain land in the City and County of NewYork with the building(s) and improvements thereon, known as 691 Eighth Avenue, designated as Block 1034, Lot 33, on the Tax Map of the City of New York (the"Tax Map"), and being more particularly described in Schedule "A" annexed hereto (said land being herein called "Owner's Parcel"). Developer owns certain land in the City and County of New York, with the existing building(s) and improvements thereon,known as 306West 44"h Street,designated as Block 1034, Lot 37, on the Tax Map and being more particularly described in Schedule "B" annexed hereto (said land being herein called "Developer's Parcel"). Developer intends to demolish or renovate, in whole or in part, the building(s) existing on Developer's Parcel and/or to construct a new building or a renovation or alteration of the present building(s) upon all or a portion of Developer's Parcel which will contain or use more floor area and development rights than are now available for use on Developer's Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution. The Parties hereto desire to utilize the'procedure available pursuant to section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution for combining Owner's Parcel and Developer's Parcel into a single zoning lot (the "Combined Zoning Lot") for the purpose of transferring Available Development Rights appurtenant to Owner's Parcel to Developers’ Parcel and Owner is willing to transfer such Available Development Rights to Developer's Parcel in perpetuity; Owner, Developer, Royal Bank of Pennsylvania and The Provident Bank constitute all of the"parties in interest" (as such term is defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution), in Owner's Parcel, as certified by First American Title Insurance Company of New York in the certificate marked Schedule "C" and annexed hereto and made a part hereof and all such "parties in interest"have executed waivers and subordinations to the Zoning Lot and Development Agreement and Declaration of Restrictions; and The parties hereto wish to set forth certain agreements with respect to their rights and obligations in and to the Combined Zoning Lot and other matters; 1 bll fth Avenue Newallc,y

NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of the premises, and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, Owner and Developer's Parcel (collectively, the "Property"), do hereby declare the following: 1.As used herein: (a)"Zoning Resolution" shall mean The Zoning Resolution of the City of  New York (the "City"), effective as of December 15, 1961, as heretofore amended August 18, 1977 and asfurther amendedfrom time to time. (b)"Floor Area Development Rights" shall mean the rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop such zoning lot by erecting thereon a structure or structures with a total floor area determined (i)bymultiplying the area of the zoninglotby the basic maximum allowablefloor arearatio for structures in the zoning district in which such zoning lot is located, and (ii) by the inclusion of any available bonus floor area and any use, bulk, density and other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution and which may be authorized to be developed by the City Planning Commission or other appropriate agency of the City. of the Floor Area Development Rights which are appurtenant to the zoning lot in which Owner's Parcel is located which are in excess of the Floor Area Development Rights utilized by thepresent building(s) located on Owner'sParcel as of the date hereof,as shown on that certain survey made by Harwood Surveying P.C. dated May 21, 1999. Owner represents and warrants that it has not constructed or installed any additional improvements, mechanical installations, towers, enclosures or other installations on Owner's Parcel since the date of such Survey. 2.  The Property is located within a single block and is hereby declared to be a tract of land to be treated as one zoning lot for the purposes of the Resolution. 3.1 shall have any effect on the treatment of the Property as one zoning lot for purposes of the Resolution and the Property shall be treated as one zoning lot unless such zoning lot is subdivided in accordance with the provisions of the Resolution. 4. Owner hereby grants, transfers, conveys and releases to Developer, its successors and assigns,forever,the Available Development Rights,together with the right to set forth in the definition of "zoning lot" in the Resolution and for which a Declaration of Restrictions or waiver thereof is duly executed by each "party in interest" in such other 2

premises, (ii) utilize the same to develop the Developer's Parcel and any other premises to which the same may be transferred pursuant to clause (i) above, and (ii) utilize any additional unused excess floor area or other unused development rights or both, attributable to other premises, which may be added to the zoning lot created hereby, as such zoning lot may be amended pursuant to paragraph 7 of this Declaration, to have and to hold the Available Development Rights and the right toso transfer and utilize the same untoDeveloper,its successor and assigns, forever. Owner represents and warrants that it has not previously or utilize the same in anymanner whatsoever.Except to the extent otherwiseprovided herein, Ownershall retain allrightsin and to the existingfloor area of thebuilding andimprovements (including bulkheads,mechanical installations, towers, enclosures and the like as they exist on the date hereof), currently located on Owner's Parcel. 5. Ownercovenants and agreesthat: (a) any new building or improvements to be constructed on the Owner's Parcel, and any reconstruction, repair or rebuilding of the buildings or improvements on the Owner's Parcel, may be made only up to a height equal to the height of the building and improvements (including bulkheads,mechanical installations,towers,enclosures and the like astheyexistonthedatehereof),currentlylocatedonOwner'sParcel,andnosuch construction, reconstruction, repair or rebuilding, if undertaken, shall be made at an elevation higher than said height; (b) Owner'sParcel shall bemadewithin thefootprintof thebuilding andimprovementslocated on the Owner's Parcel on the date hereof (including projections, bulkheads, mechanical installations, enclosures and the like as currently exist); and Owner's Parcel which requires or utilizes floor area in excess of that available to the Owner's Parcel after deducting the Available Development Rights transferred to Developer, or which which the Owner's Parcel is located,or which would enlarge or extend any existing non- conforming use, or which would increase the degree of any existing non-compliance for the zoning lot in which the Owner's Parcel is located, or which would increase the floor area of the buildings and improvements from time to time located at the Owner's Parcel. 6.  Owner and Developer agree to promptly execute and acknowledge such further instruments as Owner or Developer may reasonably request in order to carry out and effectuate the intent and purpose of this Declaration and any and all documents or instruments 3

contemplatedhereby,providedsame arenot at liability,cost,obligationor expense to Developer or Owner. In furtherance and not in limitation of the foregoing, it is agree that paragraph 20 of that certain Development Rights Purchase Agreement and Right of First Refusal, dated October 10, 2000, between Owner and Developer's predecessor-in-interest, 44- 7. Anything contained herein to the contrary notwithstanding, if Developer shall from time to time acquire additional Development Rights attributable to other premises which comply with the requirements of contiguity set forth in the definition of "zoning lot"in the Resolution and a Declaration of Restrictions (or waiver thereof) is duly executed by each "party in interest" in such other premises, then the Property and such other premises shall be deemed to be a tract of land to be treated as one zoning lot for the purposes of the Resolution. 8. Owner covenants and agrees to cooperatewithDeveloper in the use and incorporation of the Development Rights in the development of the Developer's Parcel and the merger of Owner's Parcel into one parcel with the Developer's Parcel and agrees to take all reasonable steps and to execute and deliver all instruments reasonably requested by Developer at no cost or expense to Owner to implement the foregoing. In furtherance thereof, Owner agrees that: (a) )it shall cooperatewith theDeveloper in all reasonablerespectsin improvement of the Developer's Parcel, including, but not by way of limitation, the prosecution of all zoning and variance applications relating thereto and the incorporation therein of the Development Rights, and the execution of all documents and consents pertaining thereto and reasonably required therefor (including, without limitation, the execution and delivery of an additional Zoning Lot and DevelopmentAgreement and Declaration of Restrictions). (b) neither Owner nor its agents,representatives or nominees shall voluntarily appear in opposition to Developer in any action brought, sought or defended by DeveloperbeforethePlanning Commission of theCity of NewYork,theBoard ofEstimate, the Board of Standards and Appeals, the New York City Department of Buildings, or any other city, state or federal agency, arising out of or in connection with the transfer of the Development Rights, any zoning or variance applications relating to the Developer's Parcel approval, license or ruling that, in the reasonable judgment of Developer affects or may affect applications whichDeveloper may deem necessary or desirable to any of the governmental agenciesmentioned above in order to effect the zoninglot merger,transfer of theDevelopment 4

Rights, the use by Developer of the Development Rights and their availability for and incorporation in the Developer's Parcel. be without liability or cost to Owner, or such costs will have been previously paid by or on behalf of Owner. If Developer shall request any such action on the part of Owner, Developer shall pay any reasonable attorneys’ fees incurred by Owner in connection with any such action. 9. The parties hereto agree that they will cooperate with each other in all reasonable respects, to carry out the intent of this Agreement, and in doing so, to join in any governmental application or applications necessary in connection herewith. All such action shall be at the expense (including reasonable attorneys’ fees of all parties) of the party requestingthe actioninvolved. 10.  Seller, in compliance with Section 13 of the Lien Law, covenants that it will receive the consideration for the transfer and conveyance of the Development Rights and will hold the right to receive such consideration as a trust fund to be applied first for the purpose of paying the costs of the improvement and will apply the same first to the payment of the cost of the improvement before using any part of the total of the same for such other purpose. 11. The parties hereto agree that in the event of any breach or threatened breach of this Agreement by any party, the nondefaulting party shall have the right to any remedy available at law or equity, including, but not limited to, injunctive relief. 12. This Agreement cannot be changed or terminated orally, but only by written instrument signed by the party against whom any such change or terminations asserted. 13.  All of the grants, interests, covenants, agreements and conditions contained in this Agreement: (a) shall be deemed to be covenants running with the land, and shall be binding upon the present and all subsequent owners of the Developer's Parcel and Owner's Parcel; (b) shall, except as expressly provided to the contrary in this Agreement, inure to the benefit of and be binding upon each party to this Agreement and such party's Owner'sParcel;and (c) )shall, to the extent rights hereunder are assigned to the holder of any mortgage encumbering any of the premises affected by this Agreement or any interest therein, be enforceable by or against any such assignee after default under any such mortgage. 5

14.When used herein, the term "Owner" shall refer only to the then fee owner of the Owner'sParcel and the term"Developer"shall refer only to the then fee owner of the Developer's Parcel; and any duty or obligation of the Owner or Developer, as the case may be, shall be enforceable only against the then fee owner of the Owner's parcel or the Developer's Parcel, as the case may be. 15. Any notices pursuant to this Agreement shall be given by mailing by registered or certified mail, postage prepaid, return receipt requested, addressed to each party at its addresses set forth at the head of this Agreement, or at such other address as either party may from time to time designate by notice to the other by registered or certified mail (and the holder of any mortgage encumbering any interest of any party hereto if such holder shall have given notice of its interest and an address for notices hereunder to each of the parties in accordance herewith), provided further that a copy of any notice to any party shall also be to the other party in accordance herewith. 16.This Declaration and all other information required by Section 12-10 of the Resolution shall be recorded in the ConveyancesSection of the Office of the CityRegisten (NewYorkCounty)inaccordanceswith theprovisionsofSection12-10of theResolution. 17. The parties acknowledge that the separate interests of each of them require that separate and independent tax lots, and the parties hereto agree at Developer's sole cost and oppose or object to each party's prosecuting its own tax protest proceeding with respect to its tax lotso long as the conduct thereof shall not be inconsistentwith suchseparate tax lot treatment. 18. No covenant or agreement contained herein shall inure to the benefit of any party other than Owner and Developer, their respective heirs, distributees, successors and assigns, except as specifically provided herein. The parties hereto further acknowledge and agree that nothing herein contained grants to any party the right or easement of access upon or may be entered into by or among any of the parties herein, and that, except as so specifically provided,eachpartyheretoretains full ownership of and control over its land andits estate therein. 19.  Owner hereby grants to Developer a perpetual easement of light and air over the Owner's Parcel and for this purpose Owner hereby covenants and agrees that no buiding or otherimprovementshallbeconstructedorallowedtoexistontheOwner'sParceland/or Owner's buildings and improvements nor shall any reconstruction, repair or rebuilding of the 6

existingimprovementsontheOwner'sParcelbe ataheightgreater thantheheightsof the roofs of the building on the Owner's Parcel as they now exist, except for mechanical installations or equipment on the roofs of the building located on the Owner's Parcel (including,without limitation,water tower and elevator machineryhousing)which shall not exceed the height of the presently existing installation or equipment which, together with any replacements thereof or additions thereto,may continue to exist at their present height or the covenants and agrees thatnobuildingor otherimprovement shall be constructed or allowed to exist on the Owner's Parcel having a total floor area in excess of the total floor area of the Owner'sbuilding as itnowexistsorhavingfloor areas on thegroundfloorlevels (individually, the "Footprint Area") in excess of the Footprint Area as it now exists.
